SENIOR FRONTEND DEVELOPER (React)
Auckland | Product & Design
A bit about us…
Ahwoo is a game distribution platform built on a simple idea: developers and
players deserve better. The industry has been stagnant for a while, and we're
here to change that by giving developers a fairer deal and helping players find
games worth playing.
About the role…
As a Frontend Developer, you'll help build the user-facing side of Ahwoo.com,
working closely with our product, design, and engineering teams. This isn't a
pure engineering role. We need someone who can look at a design and
implement it faithfully, with an eye for the details that matter.
A day in the life…
Translating high-fidelity Figma designs into responsive, high-performance
web interfaces.
Building and maintaining user-facing features using React.
Integrating APIs across our platform.
To get this all done, we’d like you to have:
Solid professional experience with React or similar modern frameworks.
A strong eye for design and the ability to contribute to the UX/UI of the
platform.
Proficiency with modern development workflows like GitHub
Actions and Docker
We’d love it if you also have:
A portfolio showcasing creative technologies work or complex web
projects.

JD example

11


Familiarity using Storybook to build UI separately from the entire
application.
Experience with GitHub Actions or other automation tools.
Exposure to C#, PHP, or interest in full-stack development.
Experience with web integrations or modding communities.
If this role excites you but you don't tick every box, apply anyway. We think
diverse teams build better products and welcome applications from people
regardless of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability, or any other
aspect of your culture or identity.
Hit Apply and if you’re the right fit we’ll be in touch to schedule a chat. Our
recruitment process usually involves an online chat, a visit to our office, and
reference checks.
